generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
network_unreachable: The local backend is not reachable. Start the API and try again.
request_failed: The request could not be completed.
validation_error: The information provided is not valid.
project_not_found: This project could not be found.
project_storage_missing: The project folder is missing. Restore it from a backup or remove the project.
project_storage_incomplete: The project folder is incomplete, so it cannot be backed up.
backup_invalid: That file is not a valid DocuRebuild backup.
backup_missing_files: The backup is missing required project files.
backup_unsafe_path: The backup contains an unsafe path and was not restored.
backup_database_invalid: The project database in the backup is damaged or incomplete.
backup_incompatible: This backup was created by a newer or unsupported version of DocuRebuild.
backup_too_large: The backup is larger than the configured size limit.
backup_import_running: Wait for the running import to finish before creating a backup.
backup_incomplete: Project files changed while the backup was written. Try again.
backup_verification_failed: The backup could not be verified, so it was not downloaded.
backup_restore_failed: The backup could not be restored as a new project.
backup_password_too_short: Use a backup password of at least 8 characters.
backup_password_too_long: Use a backup password of at most 1024 characters.
backup_password_required: This backup is encrypted. Enter its password to restore it.
backup_wrong_password: That password is incorrect for this backup.
backup_corrupt: The encrypted backup is damaged or incomplete, so it was not restored.
restore_selection_expired: This page selection has expired. Inspect the backup again.
page_selection_empty: Select at least one page to restore.
page_selection_invalid: One or more selected pages are not in this backup.
backup_no_pages: This backup contains no pages to restore.
backup_too_many_pages: This backup has more pages than a selective restore supports.
unsupported_file_type: That file type isn’t supported yet. Use JPG, PNG, WEBP, BMP, TIFF or PDF.
image_unreadable: One of the images could not be read.
pdf_unavailable: PDF support is not installed on this device.
pdf_unreadable: The PDF file could not be read.
pdf_encrypted: Password-protected PDFs are not supported. Remove the password first.
pdf_empty: The PDF does not contain any pages.
pdf_too_many_pages: The PDF has too many pages for one import. Split it and try again.
pdf_page_render_failed: One of the PDF pages could not be rendered.
pdf_font_missing: PDF export needs a Myanmar font on this device. Install Noto Sans Myanmar or Padauk, or set DOCUREBUILD_PDF_FONT to a font file.
file_too_large: The file is larger than the current import limit.
too_many_files: Too many files were selected for one batch.
invalid_page_order: The new page order was invalid. Nothing was changed.
page_not_found: This page could not be found.
asset_not_found: The image file could not be found.
asset_file_missing: The image file is missing from the project folder.
ocr_unavailable: A local OCR engine is not available. Install Tesseract and try again.
ocr_language_unavailable: The selected OCR language data is not installed.
ocr_page_has_no_source: This page has no image to process.
ocr_run_not_found: The OCR result could not be found.
ocr_block_not_found: That OCR text block could not be found.
ocr_not_ready: OCR has not finished for this page yet.
ocr_image_unreadable: The page image could not be prepared for OCR.
ocr_timeout: OCR timed out. Try a smaller page or increase the OCR timeout.
ocr_failed: OCR could not read this page. Check the local engine and try again.
ocr_worker_unavailable: The local OCR worker is not available.
ocr_stale: The page changed after OCR. Run OCR again before using this text.
ocr_block_empty: This OCR text block has no text to review.
table_block_required: Only a block labelled as a table can produce a table proposal.
table_source_modified: This block was corrected by hand. Re-run OCR to rebuild its table from the engine's word positions.
table_no_words: This result has no word positions. Re-run OCR to build a table proposal.
table_not_detected: The stored word positions do not form a table with at least two rows and two columns.
table_element_required: Only a saved table region can be read as a table.
table_crop_empty: Local OCR did not find any words in this crop. Check that the region covers the table and that the OCR language is installed.
table_crop_not_detected: The crop's text does not form a table with at least two rows and two columns. Adjust the region so it covers the whole table.
element_has_no_crop: This region has no saved crop image to read.
table_too_large: The proposed table is too large to review safely. Split the page or crop the table into a smaller region.
import_job_not_found: This import job could not be found.
import_not_running: This import has already finished and cannot be cancelled.
import_failed: The import could not be completed. Check the selected files and try again.
import_interrupted: The import was interrupted before it finished. Pages that were already saved have been kept.
import_worker_unavailable: The local import worker is not available. Restart the app and try again.
ai_unreachable: The local AI server is not reachable. Start it and check the URL in Settings.
ai_timeout: The local AI server did not answer in time. It may still be loading the model.
ai_http_error: The local AI server returned an error. Check its log and the configured URL.
ai_rate_limited: The AI provider is rate limiting requests right now. Nothing was retried automatically; wait and try again, or check the provider's free-tier limits.
ai_auth_failed: The AI provider refused the request. Check the saved API key and whether it can use the selected model.
ai_invalid_response: The local AI server replied in an unexpected format. Check that it is Ollama or OpenAI-compatible.
ai_not_configured: Choose a local AI model in Settings before using AI assistance.
ai_vision_not_configured: Choose a vision model in Settings before using AI image analysis.
ai_page_image_missing: This page image is not available for AI analysis. Try reopening the page or re-importing it.
ai_element_image_missing: This region's saved crop is not available for AI analysis. Draw or extract the region again.
ai_equation_empty: The AI server returned no equation. The LaTeX source was left unchanged.
ai_equation_region_required: Only an equation region can be transcribed as LaTeX.
ai_empty_response: The local AI server returned no text. The OCR text was left unchanged.
ai_text_too_long: This text is too long for one AI request. Split it or review it manually.
ai_remote_not_allowed: This AI server is not on localhost. Enable remote AI consent in Settings before sending text to it.
ai_request_limit_reached: The AI request limit for the last 24 hours has been reached. Change the limit in Settings or try again later.
ai_suggestion_not_found: This AI proposal could not be found.
ai_suggestion_not_pending: This AI proposal was already accepted or rejected.
ai_suggestion_stale: The OCR text changed after this proposal was created. Request a new proposal.
invalid_ai_settings: The local AI settings are not valid. Check the URL and model.
invalid_ai_suggestion_status: That proposal decision is not valid.
not_found: The requested item could not be found.
internal_error: The local backend encountered an unexpected error.
ai_connection_not_found: This AI connection could not be found.
ai_key_not_found: That API key could not be found.
ai_model_not_found: That model could not be found in the connection catalog.
ai_model_exists: This model is already in the connection catalog.
ai_model_required: Choose a model for this route.
ai_model_not_in_catalog: The selected model is not in this connection's catalog. Refresh the model list or add it manually.
ai_model_missing_vision: This model does not accept image input. Choose a vision-capable model.
ai_model_missing_text: This model does not produce text. Choose a text model.
ai_model_unavailable: The selected model is not available from the provider right now.
ai_task_model_incompatible: The selected model cannot serve this task. Choose another model.
ai_unknown_task: That AI task is not known to this build.
ai_unknown_provider: That AI provider is not supported by this build.
ai_invalid_cost_class: Choose local, free or paid as the cost class.
ai_invalid_rotation: That key rotation strategy is not valid.
ai_budget_exceeded: The monthly AI budget for this connection has been reached. Raise the budget in Settings to continue.
ai_task_limit_reached: The request limit for this task has been reached. Change the route limit in Settings or try again later.
ai_connection_limit_reached: The request limit for this connection has been reached. Change it in Settings or try again later.
ai_paid_confirmation_required: This AI route is marked paid. Confirm the request before it is sent.
ai_no_available_key: No enabled API key is ready for this connection. Add a key or wait for its cooldown to end.
ai_task_not_configured: Choose a connection and model for this AI task in Settings before using it.
ai_https_required: Remote AI endpoints must use HTTPS. HTTP is only allowed on this device.
ai_invalid_url: That AI endpoint URL is not valid.
ai_url_not_allowed: That AI endpoint is not allowed. Use a public provider URL or a loopback address on this device.
ai_base_url_required: Enter the endpoint URL for this provider.
ai_manual_model_unsupported: This provider does not allow manually added models.
ai_model_discovery_unsupported: This provider has no model list endpoint. Add a model ID manually.
ai_provider_unavailable: The AI provider is not available right now.
ai_endpoint_not_found: The provider endpoint was not found. Check the URL, including the API version path.
ai_api_key_required: Add an API key before testing this connection.
ai_api_key_empty: Enter an API key, or leave the field blank to keep the saved one.
ai_api_key_too_long: This API key is too long to store.
ai_api_key_invalid: This API key contains characters the provider will not accept.
ai_key_store_failed: The API key could not be saved in the local encrypted vault. Check the data folder and try again.
ai_permission_denied: This API key is not allowed to use that endpoint or model.
ai_table_empty: The AI reply contained no table cells. Nothing was inserted.
ai_table_ragged: The AI table reply has rows of different lengths. Nothing was inserted.
ai_table_too_large: The AI table reply is too large to review safely. Crop a smaller table.
ai_table_region_required: Only a table region can be read as a table.
ai_preferences: The AI limits could not be saved. Check the values and try again.
ai_migration: Legacy AI settings could not be migrated. Your previous values are unchanged.
reset_confirmation_required: Type DELETE exactly to confirm the factory reset.
reset_incomplete: DocuRebuild could not remove every data file. Close other applications that may be using the data folder, then try again.
reset_unsafe_location: The configured data folder is too broad to reset safely. Choose a dedicated DocuRebuild folder.
reset_data_dir_invalid: The configured data folder is not a directory, so it was not reset.
project_delete_failed: This project could not be deleted. Its files were not changed.
project_storage_outside_data_dir: This project's folder is stored outside the DocuRebuild data folder, so it was not deleted. Restore the data folder to its original location first.
